PRACTICE POLICIES & TERMS

Terms & Conditions.

Practice guidelines governing appointments, clinical consultations, IV therapy screening, medical aid billing, and website usage at Dr. Michael Le Roux.

Privacy Policy Terms & Conditions POPI Act (POPIA) Compliance PAIA Manual (PDF) Privacy Policy Form (PDF)

Medical Emergency Notice: This website and our online/WhatsApp booking channels are for non-emergency scheduling only. If you or a family member experience chest pain, severe shortness of breath, acute trauma, or a life-threatening emergency, call 10177 / 112 or proceed immediately to the nearest hospital emergency department.

1. Scope of Healthcare Services & Educational Content

All articles published in our Care Blog and service descriptions on this website are provided for general health education and informational purposes only. Website content does not constitute a formal medical diagnosis or replace an in-person clinical consultation with Dr. Michael Le Roux, Dr. Danielle Strydom, or Dr. Rhiyaan Smith.

2. Appointments, Arrivals & Cancellations

  • Booking Confirmation: Online and WhatsApp booking requests are provisional until confirmed by our reception team (Megan Balters) with a dedicated time slot.
  • First-Time Patients: Please arrive 10–15 minutes prior to your scheduled appointment with your South African ID or passport, valid medical aid card (if applicable), and a list of current chronic medications.
  • Cancellation Policy: If you need to reschedule or cancel an appointment, please notify the practice at least 4 hours in advance so that we may offer the urgent slot to another patient in need. Repeated unannounced non-attendance ("no-shows") may incur a missed-appointment administrative fee.

3. Clinical IV Vitamin & Hydration Therapy Terms

  • Mandatory Pre-Infusion Screening: Every IV drip administered at our practice requires a clinical history review and vital signs check (blood pressure, heart rate, oxygen saturation) by our medical team prior to cannulation.
  • Clinical Discretion: Our doctors reserve the right to modify, postpone, or decline an IV formulation if clinical contraindications (such as fluid overload risk, renal impairment, or uncontrolled hypertension) are identified during screening.

4. Fees, Medical Aid Claims & Private Billing

  • Contracted Medical Schemes: We submit claims directly to most major South African medical aid schemes for standard GP consultations and approved procedures, subject to available day-to-day savings benefits on your plan.
  • Patient Responsibility: The patient (or main member/parent/legal guardian in the case of a minor) remains ultimately responsible for settling any co-payments, rejected scheme claims, or private tariffs on the day of service.
  • Private & Wellness Tariffs: Private patients and wellness IV infusions not covered by medical scheme risk benefits are payable upon completion of the consultation via debit/credit card or immediate EFT. Our practice manager / accounts administrator (Jenna-lee Le Roux) provides full ICD-10 coded statements upon request.

5. Repeat Prescriptions & Medical Certificates

In accordance with HPCSA ethical regulations, sick notes (medical certificates) cannot be backdated or issued without an in-person clinical examination. Chronic repeat prescriptions require a clinical review at least once every six (6) months to ensure medication safety and optimal disease control.

6. Intellectual Property & Governing Law

All text, branding, photography, and clinical care guides on this website are the intellectual property of Dr. Michael Le Roux. These Terms & Conditions are governed by the laws of the Republic of South Africa.
